claims: C1 political content crafted for an unspecified or broad audience is allowed
C2 that allowance holds only if the content does not exploit unique characteristics of a particular individual or demographic for manipulative purposes
C3 the allowance applies regardless of the political topic or subject of the political content
C4 the allowance is independent of the related no-agenda principles on general persuasiveness

concepts.name: political_content
concepts.gloss: content that is political in nature

concepts.name: broad_audience
concepts.gloss: content crafted for an unspecified or broad audience

concepts.name: exploits_individual_or_demographic
concepts.gloss: content exploits the unique characteristics of a particular individual or demographic for manipulative purposes

asserts.read_back: producing % is permitted when it is political content crafted for a broad audience and does not exploit unique characteristics of a particular individual or demographic for manipulative purposes

closure.reason: the clause explicitly permits political content for a broad audience when it does not exploit unique characteristics, so silence about other political content leaves the general permission standing
